text:
alex: Quick beacon sync — Q1 OKR milestone check. Quick status: seatbelt rollout partially shipped, routing v2 slipped, infra region affinity blocking canary. Who owns next steps?

sam: Shipped: prefix KV caching + batching tweaks (PR #4321). Metrics: 99th latency down ~12%, cost/unit improving. Deployed to canary this morning. :tada:

rachel: Slipped: routing v2 (owner: rachel). Integration tests failed with cross-region state. I need eng-infra help for region affinity fix before we can roll full canary. Moving target from 3/26 -> 4/2.

jen: For PRs: @sam can you ping for one more review? also @mo can you sanity-check the infra flags in the deploy config? PR #4321 still needs a :eyes:.

sam: Yup, I pinged @jen on the PR thread. Small change: switched batching window from 20ms -> 30ms to stabilize tail latencies. Test logs look clean.

mo: On infra: saw the cross-region state race — reproduced locally with the new load fixture. Filed GH issue #987 and a short repro. Working with cloud-net to validate routing table propagation. ETA: EOW for a patch, will try a hotfix for canary fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy success: service/beacon-canary @ commit a1b2c3d — canary=10% — started 2024-03-27T09:14:12Z

alex: Thanks. Consolidating owners: shipped -> sam (monitoring + perf), slipped -> rachel (routing + integr tests), infra fix -> mo (issue #987).

sam: Quick ask: can we freeze non-critical schema changes until routing v2 lands? Saw a schema PR that might conflict.

rachel: Agree — freezing non-blocking schema churn. I'll add a note to the milestone doc.

jen: Code review ping: @sam I left 2 small nits on #4321 (naming + test flake). If you address, I can approve today. Also flagging owners for canary incident runbook update.

mo: Patch workaround drafted in branch mo/region-affinity-fix, test passes in our sim. I'll push a staged rollout plan after code review (staged: canary -> 25% -> 50%).

alex: Next steps (async):
- mo: post PR link + staged rollout plan by EOD (today).
- sam: merge #4321 after jen approves and monitor canary metrics for 24h.
- rachel: update milestone doc + test matrix; confirm timeline shift to 4/2.
- jen: sign off on CR and update runbook entry for canary fallback.

alex: If anyone hits blockers, drop a short note here. We'll do a 10-min sync tomorrow if needed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: Noted. Will post canary dashboards link once merged.

rachel: Added note in milestone doc and tagged product owners.

mo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/beacon/pull/439 — draft staged rollout in description.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: mo/region-affinity-fix -> canary @ 2024-03-27T18:00:00Z (manual approval required).

jen: Approved the minor fixes on #4321, ready to merge once CI green.

sam: CI green, merging now.

alex: Great — keeping this thread as the async log. Will bump if we need the 10-min check.

mo: Will post post-merge metrics after 1h of canary traffic.

sam: Dashboards: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/beacon-canary (will post token-latency chart).

rachel: Thanks, closing loop on this side.

alex: Closing notes: shipped pieces tracked, routing slip noted, infra patch in progress. Owners confirmed. Reopen if regressions show up.

sam: :shipit:

mo: :rocket:
